elaine: Heads-up — the Python quickstart on docs is out of sync. Two things I hit this morning: the pip install line points to `redwood-inference==0.8.1` but our package has 0.9.x releases, and the retry example in the snippet doesn't actually enable retries in the SDK (shows a `retry=True` flag that the client doesn't accept). Also the "async client" link 404s.

sam: Ugh, I ran into the same. Minimal repro below — docs say call `generate(model='gpt-small', prompt='hi')` but my local client raises: `TypeError: generate() got an unexpected keyword argument 'model'`.

sam: ```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "quickstart.py", line 12, in <module>
    resp = client.generate(model='gpt-small', prompt='hello')
TypeError: generate() got an unexpected keyword argument 'model'
```

maria: Thanks for filing this, @elaine. I suspect the docs were authored against the 0.9 API shape but the package on PyPI is still 0.8.1. I can push a quick docs patch to fix the install line and the snippet to use the correct param name `model_name` (or we should change the SDK to accept `model` for parity). Which do we prefer?

elaine: Prefer changing docs unless eng wants to maintain the legacy alias. The bigger problem is the retry example — docs show: `client = Client(retry=True)` but current SDK requires a `RetryConfig` object and `client.enable_retries()` call. New users are confused.

dev-rel: @eng-docs / @eng-runtime decision needed. Two options: update docs to current SDK (fast) or add a tiny compatibility layer to accept `retry=True` and `model=` in the client (breaking change risk). Personally vote docs update + a note in changelog.

sam: I'll open a small repro issue with exact callstack and environment: Python 3.11, redwood-inference 0.8.1, macOS. Repro gist: https://gist.github.com/sam/quickstart-repro (private).

doc-bot: Automated docs deploy report: previous build -> warning: linkcheck failed for /docs/quickstart/python -> 404 on /docs/quickstart/python/async-client.

maria: I opened PR #492 to: update pip line to `pip install redwood-inference==0.9.0`, change snippet to `client = Client(model_name="gpt-small", retry_config=RetryConfig(max_attempts=3))`, and fix the async-client link target. Also added a note about typing: `Client` now has stricter type hints, so sample `client.generate()` calls should include `-> Response` examples.

elaine: Nice. Can we also add a one-line smoke test in our docs CI that runs the quickstart snippet (in a venv) so snippet drift gets caught? I can sketch a tiny GH action.

chris: Adding a smoke test is 👍. I'll add a tiny runner that installs the pinned package from the docs build and runs the example for Python 3.10/3.11 matrix. If it fails, docs CI will fail and we can catch drift.

dev-rel: Also let's add a small note in the SDK changelog about the param rename and example change so users see it during upgrade.

sam: Quick note — because typing got stricter, some internal customers reported pyright errors in their monorepos (generation helper wrappers). We should add a short section in the quickstart about the new typed client and an example stub for `from redwood import Client, Response` and usage.

maria: Will include that in the PR. Also pinging @eng-runtime for a decision on a possible micro-backward-compat alias.

elaine: Thanks everyone. Filing an umbrella issue: https://redwood-internal/issue/7800 "quickstart docs drift: install, retry, typing, async link" — feel free to link PRs. :thumbsup:

chris: I'll follow up with the GH Action and a link to the test plan.

doc-bot: docs deploy succeeded for branch fix/quickstart-493 at 2024-11-03 14:12:23 UTC

maria: Patch merged to main. Leaving a follow-up to track adding the example smoke test to CI.

elaine: Great, thanks. If anyone else sees odd snippet mismatches, please drop them here so we can batch fixes. :eyes:
